create_orm_base: create a SQLAlchemy MappedAsDataclass declarative base for UCO3D annotation models
define_frame_annotation_model: define a UCO3DFrameAnnotation ORM model with composite columns for image, depth, mask, and viewpoint data
define_sequence_annotation_model: define a UCO3DSequenceAnnotation ORM model with composite columns for video, point clouds, and reconstruction quality
build_composite_annotation_columns: build composite mapped columns that group related fields into annotation dataclass types
query_frame_annotations: query UCO3D frame annotations by sequence name and frame number using the frame_annots table
